pair_definition: simple random sample without replacement of unordered nonself pairs from frozen pool; orientation follows increasing endpoint index
distance: ordinary Euclidean norm in saved principal joint coordinates, matching prior Fig3; no torus redefinition
candidate_rule: each partition checked once with own 512-midpoint deterministic RBS; existential union of exact same cached candidate outcomes for every m; timeout is UNKNOWN
bounded_rule: actual production PCS RBS with nested partition set, ascending order, first success, one 512-midpoint budget shared among trials, 2 second wall cap
inference: Exact descriptive rates on 180 frozen pairs. No confidence interval or population-general performance claim: endpoints come from 13 previously successful saved paths and pairs share endpoints.
